title: EB-gMCR: Energy-Based Generative Modeling for Signal Unmixing and Multivariate Curve Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2507.23600v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A single measurement of a chemical mixture, a reaction mixture, a natural extract, or a tissue, records the sum of the profiles of the few components it contains, each weighted by its concentration. Recovering the components and their concentrations from a collection of such samples is multivariate curve resolution (MCR). Classical MCR factorizes the data matrix, takes the component count as input, and leaves a rotational ambiguity that constraints narrow. This paper keeps the forward direction and models how a sample is made: each sample activates a few components from a pool of candidate components and is observed as their linear superposition plus noise. Under this model the continuous ambiguity of factorization collapses to the numbering of the components, and among all decompositions that reproduce the data, the one with the fewest component occurrences across samples is the true one. We prove three results. Under a spark condit

translated_title: EB-gMCR：基于能量的生成建模用于信号解混与多变量曲线分辨
translated_abstract: 对化学混合物、反应混合物、天然提取物或组织进行单次测量时，记录的是其中少数组分信号曲线的总和，每个组分按其浓度加权。从这样的一组样本中恢复各组分及其浓度，即为多变量曲线分辨（MCR）。经典的MCR方法对数据矩阵进行因式分解，需要以组分数目作为输入，并存在只能通过约束条件缩小的旋转不确定性。本文保持正向建模思路，对样本的生成方式进行建模：每个样本从候选组分池中激活少数几个组分，并被观测为这些组分信号的线性叠加加上噪声。在该模型下，因式分解的连续不确定性被简化为组分的编号问题，而在所有能够重现数据的分解中，组分在各样本中出现次数最少的那个分解才是真实的。我们证明了三个结果。在稀疏条件……（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出EB-gMCR方法，通过基于能量的生成建模将多变量曲线分辨问题转化为样本生成过程的正向建模，并证明在所有能重现数据的分解中，组分出现次数最少的分解即为真实解，从而解决了传统因式分解方法的旋转不确定性和组分数依赖问题。
en_tdlr: EB-gMCR reformulates multivariate curve resolution as a forward generative process using energy-based modeling, proving that among all data-reproducing decompositions, the one with the fewest component occurrences across samples is the true one, thereby resolving rotational ambiguity.
